definitions.gloss: conversion to cash; cashing in; liquidation
definitions.explanation: Turning goods, securities, or other assets into money by selling them. Used as a noun and with する as a transitive verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{換金|かんきん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I converted my stocks into cash.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}{券|けん}→商品券：22121_shouhinken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{換金|かんきん}⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This gift voucher cannot be exchanged for cash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{換金|かんきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I suddenly needed money, so I decided to cash in the gold I had.

notes:
Compound of {換|かん} (exchange) + {金|きん} (money). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a transitive verb (X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{換金|かんきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {換金|かんきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert to cash
- {換金|かんきん}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: liquidity (ease of converting to cash)
- {換金|かんきん}⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧: cash crop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧: money exchange — swapping one currency or denomination for another, not selling assets
- {現金化|げんきんか}: turning into cash — near-synonym, often used for vouchers and points
